title: Home practical guide and safety card: black and white cups in sunshine
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
source: Written for gcse-science/y10 lesson 104 (Home practical guide and safety card: black and white cups in sunshine (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 104: Convection in everyday life and surfaces that radiate. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which surface absorbs more radiation from the Sun
equipment: A sunny windowsill and a timer
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Wrap one cup in black paper and the other in white paper
Put the same volume of cold tap water in each
Measure the starting temperature of each
Stand both in the same sunny place
Measure the temperature every 5 minutes for 30 minutes

questions.q: Big question: why does the breeze change direction at night?
questions.a: The sea is then warmer than the land, so air rises over the sea.
